ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To buy a hat by measuring the head is to choose the hat by first taking the wearer’s measure.
EvidenceBody: Tiantong Jue pairs the phrase with deciding whether someone is son or thief and removing bones before eating fish. Xutang says simply, “here I buy a hat by measuring the head,” while the Collected Essentials calls an exact fit difficult. These clauses establish measured fitting and discriminating selection; they do not by themselves define it as conceptual calculation.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The phrase enters Chan appraisals as an image of fitting or discriminating by the person before one.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The evidence does not establish that every use condemns advance calculation; Xutang uses it without an explicit rebuke.
